title: Add unhandledRejection/uncaughtException handlers to adapter
description: P0 from 10-agent audit (escalated by council). MineflayerAdapter/index.js has no process.on('unhandledRejection') or process.on('uncaughtException') handlers. In Node.js 22+, unhandled rejections terminate the process. Any unhandled promise rejection kills the adapter without cleanup, triggering unnecessary C# reconnect. Add handlers that log and attempt clean shutdown. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md (P0-003).

comments.body: Duplicate of TSK-0388 which is already Done. TSK-0388 implemented unhandledRejection/uncaughtException handlers in commit e1f1a34. Archiving this copy.
